Tushar Deshpande's hat-trick gives Mumbai advantage in Ranji Trophy match

Tushar Deshpande took a hat-trick, finishing with 5 wickets for 17 runs on his 50th first-class appearance, to put Mumbai in command against Chandigarh in a Ranji Trophy match. Chandigarh trailed by 351 runs.
